title: Didactic knowledge or Clinical Cases? How Data Types Shape Medical Large Language Models
description:
arXiv:2609.22161v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Medical large language models are commonly trained on mixtures of didactic data (e.g., textbooks) and clinical data (e.g., patient records), yet how these data types differentially shape model capabilities remains unclear.
